title: Use Conservation of Momentum
text: The conservation of momentum suggests that $$p_{\text{before}}=p_{\text{after}}.$$ Here, $$p_{\text{before}}=m_{\text{asteroid}}v_{\text{asteroid}}+m_{\text{Moon}}v_{\text{Moon}}$$ and $$p_{\text{after}}=(m_{\text{asteroid}}+m_{\text{Moon}})v_{\text{final}}$$.
